full.title: Whatever Happened To MySpace? | How a $580M Internet Giant Fell
full.description:
MySpace was once the center of online culture — custom profiles, Top 8 drama, profile songs, Tom, MySpace Music, and millions of people logging in every day. Then Facebook took over, the site lost momentum, and a company bought for about $580 million was sold years later for roughly $35 million.

Marcus breaks down how MySpace rose, why it mattered, what really went wrong, and the legacy it left behind.
